TEXT:
[FI] As the end of our summer holidays approached, 
the Game Research Club gathered for a second 
meeting.

[FI] After reflecting on what happened last time, I 
made my preparations. Sena probably has too.
[FI] But, it seems we're not the only ones.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I recommend creating Akagi-san's game this time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Y-You're fine with it, Gokou-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Yes. My game was made for the game contest last 
time, and another one of mine was prepared for 
Summer Comiket.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] If we're starting off with a new project, we should 
be using one of yours instead of mine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] I mean, surely you aren't satisfied constantly 
supporting other people's projects?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...Gokou-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...What's the matter?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Ah... it's nothing. But, thank you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] There's no reason to thank me. I'm just saying 
what's right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Moreover, if we both keep being stubborn about 
our demands, nothing will get done.

[FI] I see, she's also done some thinking of her own 
since last time.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Then, since I have Gokou-san's approval, that means 
I can make a tasteful homo-game to my heart's 
content, right? Should I go macho or shota?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] P-Please wait. I said I supported you but, I can't 
just let you do as you please.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Of course, as a doujin game, we should base it on 
what we like but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] If you go all-out, it will only create chaos for us.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] I agree. If you make your uncensored delusions a 
reality, in the worst-case, our club will get 
suspended on the first day of the cultural festival.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] My heart will be broken as well...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I-I understand. I'll compromise at that point. I'll 
lighten up on the BL elements and focus more on 
RPG gameplay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Please do.

[FI] Mutual compromise, huh...? It's great that we could 
solve this peacefully.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm not trying to put you down, but making a 
time-consuming RPG game isn't exactly fitting for 
the cultural festival, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Good point, Kousaka. You're right, when you want 
to show the appeal of a game in a short period of 
time, RPGs and novel games aren't suitable.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] That's why I made a shooting game back when we 
were recruiting new members.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, that shitty game.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: [FI] Guohhhhh! Y-You really don't pull your punches!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]But it's truly a shitty game.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Yep, a shitty game.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: [FI] ...You guys... have more sympathy for your senior...!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] Everyone's so cruel. There's some merit on what 
he's saying, so let's just take that point into 
consideration, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: [FI] Ohh, Makabe! You're my only ally!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] I must admit all your games are shitty though.

[FI] That was the finishing blow. He's completely 
speechless. Lifting him up to fall... that trick is scary...

[FI] Watching the two of them go at each other, a 
certain girl was completely entranced.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] My oh my. Fufufu...
[FI] Just what is she imagining them doing in her brain...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] At any rate, we'll just come up with a bunch of 
ideas to make up for it. Like preparing a trailer or 
introducing action mechanics.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] Can you consider adding that in, Akagi-san? Or 
would it be better for Gokou-san to work on it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I... feel that I'm better suited to handle the tweaking 
of mechanics to enhance the game.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But you're leading the project this time, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] You're gonna write the scenario, cut the content, 
balance the game... You have to debug the game as 
well, you can't keep up with all of that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] That's true... But, that's not really your field of 
expertise either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's true, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: [FI] How about letting me handle the design?

SPEAKER: SPK_BOTH
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]No thank you.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: [FI] ...My... My juniors don't have any faith in me...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] Cheer up, please. In a way, we do have faith in you... 
that you have no sense of game design.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Are you trying to cheer me up or choke the life 
out of me?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey... Can I say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] What is it? Kousaka-senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Actually... I've thought about it at home, who should 
be working on what, I mean.
